objective: Build an app which can show preview of photos from a given folder, ability to go next or previous. Provide copy button which can copy the current image into a designated folder. Build as C# Windows App
definitionOfDone: A C# Windows desktop app lets the user select a source photo folder and a destination folder.
Supported photos are listed deterministically and the current photo is previewed without locking the source file.
Previous and Next navigation works at boundaries and communicates current position.
Copy copies the current photo to the destination without silently overwriting an existing file.
The UI handles empty folders, unsupported or unreadable images, missing folders, and copy errors explicitly.
The solution builds in Release and automated tests cover photo discovery, navigation, and copy collision behavior.
Independent test, code review, desktop QA, and engineering judgment approve the implementation.
